answer_1.quote: The primary objective of our benchmark is to rigorously evaluate the capability of text-to-image generation models to render accurate and coherent text embedded within synthetic images.
tasks: Other:Text-to-image generation with embedded text rendering
answer_1.outputs: images containing embedded text generated from natural language prompts

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of the rendered text by comparing the OCR output to the ground truth using similarity metrics, including normalized edit distance (NED), character error rate (CER), and word error rate (WER).
